proof_scope: Skills-first project setup planning/auditing for the OpenAI interview repo, including curate-client brief handoff, README provenance, immutable goal, Docker/Terraform handoff, and retained eval proof.

claims.proves: setup-project can emit a read-only setup plan and audit the openai-interview repo for the setup surfaces interviewers need to inspect.
claims.does_not_prove: full project generation, production deployment, or cloud apply.

capability_claims.description: The skill emits a typed read-only plan for setting up the OpenAI interview project with the required skill chain.
The skill audits the OpenAI interview repo for README skill provenance, curate-client handoff, immutable goal, Docker/Terraform files, and retained eval fixture.

cases.name: openai-plan-includes-curate-client
command: ../run.sh plan --config ../configs/openai_interview.yaml | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["schema"]=="setup_project.plan_receipt.v1" and d["status"]=="PASS"; assert "curate-client" in d["required_skills"]; assert d["curate_client_plan"]["status"]=="PASS"; print("SETUP_PLAN_OK")'

cases.name: openai-audit-proves-readme-and-goal
command: ../run.sh audit --config ../configs/openai_interview.yaml | python3 -c 'import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); assert d["schema"]=="setup_project.audit_receipt.v1" and d["status"]=="PASS"; assert d["curate_client_plan_status"]=="PASS"; assert d["curate_client_verify_status"]=="PASS" and d["curate_client_probe_count"] >= 5; assert d["immutable_goal_valid"] is True; assert d["assembly_evidence"]["schema"]=="setup_project.assembly_evidence.v1"; assert d["assembly_evidence"]["commit_count"] >= 1; assert not d["missing_readme_terms"]; print("SETUP_AUDIT_OK")'

cases.name: audit-fails-when-required-file-missing
command:
TMPD=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet --local /home/graham/workspace/experiments/openai-interview $TMPD/project; rm $TMPD/project/README.md; python3 - <<PYCODE > $TMPD/config.yaml
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
d=yaml.safe_load(Path('../configs/openai_interview.yaml').read_text())
d['project_root']='$TMPD/project'
print(yaml.safe_dump(d))
PYCODE
../run.sh audit --config $TMPD/config.yaml >/tmp/setup_project_missing_file.out 2>/tmp/setup_project_missing_file.err; test $? -eq 1; grep -Fq 'missing_files' /tmp/setup_project_missing_file.out

cases.name: audit-fails-when-immutable-goal-invalid
command:
TMPD=$(mktemp -d); git clone --quiet --local /home/graham/workspace/experiments/openai-interview $TMPD/project; python3 - <<PYCODE
import json
from pathlib import Path
path=Path('$TMPD/project/immutable_goal.json')
d=json.loads(path.read_text())
d.pop('classification', None)
path.write_text(json.dumps(d))
PYCODE
python3 - <<PYCODE > $TMPD/config.yaml
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
d=yaml.safe_load(Path('../configs/openai_interview.yaml').read_text())
d['project_root']='$TMPD/project'
print(yaml.safe_dump(d))
PYCODE
../run.sh audit --config $TMPD/config.yaml >/tmp/setup_project_bad_goal.out 2>/tmp/setup_project_bad_goal.err; test $? -eq 1; grep -Fq 'immutable_goal_invalid' /tmp/setup_project_bad_goal.out

cases.name: audit-fails-when-curate-client-plan-fails
command:
TMP=$(mktemp -d); python3 - <<'PYCODE' > $TMP/config.yaml
import yaml
from pathlib import Path
d=yaml.safe_load(Path('../configs/openai_interview.yaml').read_text())
d['curate_client_config']='/tmp/definitely-missing-curate-client-config.yaml'
print(yaml.safe_dump(d))
PYCODE
../run.sh audit --config $TMP/config.yaml >/tmp/setup_project_bad_curate.out 2>/tmp/setup_project_bad_curate.err; test $? -eq 1; grep -Fq 'curate_client_plan_failed' /tmp/setup_project_bad_curate.out
